name: OpenRestream

site.name: OpenRestream
site.what: Ingest once and send the stream to every platform at once; keys, destinations and output health in one place.
site.description: OpenRestream is OpenVibe's open streaming engine, split out of OpenVibe.Live. Go live from a web browser with no OBS, no downloads and no follower minimum, or send RTMP or WHIP from any encoder, and restream to Twitch, YouTube, Kick and any RTMP, RTMPS or SRT destination. Browser broadcasts start on OpenVibe.Live today, and move to OpenRestream ingest channel by channel.

pillars.title: Browser go-live
pillars.text: Stream from a browser over WebRTC and WHIP, with nothing to install and no follower minimum.

pillars.title: Ingest
pillars.text: RTMP ingest with keys and lifecycle in one place, plus WHIP/WebRTC; SRT ingest to follow.

pillars.title: Restream
pillars.text: Twitch, YouTube, Kick and any RTMP, RTMPS or SRT destination.

pillars.title: Open API and SDK
pillars.text: Streams, sessions and destinations through the OpenVibe API and SDK; run it yourself from GitHub.

faq.question: Can I stream without OBS?
faq.answer: Yes. Go live from your browser on OpenVibe.Live: press Go Live, allow your camera and microphone, and you are live. There is nothing to install.

faq.question: Do I need followers or subscribers to go live?
faq.answer: No. Every OpenVibe account can go live from the first minute, with no follower, subscriber or past-stream requirement.

faq.question: Can I stream from a Chromebook or a phone?
faq.answer: Yes. The broadcaster runs in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari, on ChromeOS, Android and iOS as well as Windows, macOS and Linux.

faq.question: Can I restream to Twitch, YouTube and Kick at the same time?
faq.answer: Yes. One broadcast can go to Twitch, YouTube, Kick and any RTMP, RTMPS or SRT server at once.

faq.question: Can I use OBS if I want to?
faq.answer: Yes. OBS and any RTMP encoder work, and so do WHIP encoders (OBS 30 and later, ffmpeg, GStreamer).

meanwhile.label: Go live on OpenVibe.Live
meanwhile.note: Ingest and restreaming run inside Live today.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP (openre-api; the coordinator and workers are separate processes); it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

drains: openre-api: handles closed; workers are separate processes and keep running
openre-session-coordinator: coordinator stopped, then the database
SIGTERM starts a drain: the public listener closes; publishers and restream outputs keep running until they end or OPENRE_DRAIN_MAX_MS (default 24 h) passes
at that deadline ingest sessions end and restream outputs move to the newest generation; the worker exits 0 once idle

shutdown.note: api and coordinator force-exit after 10 s; ovhost never stops or restarts the worker units (a deploy starts a new generation and the coordinator drains the old one)

resumes.what: the coordinator fails the open sessions of workers without a heartbeat (worker_lost) and of expired leases; their outputs go back to pending for the newest restream generation
a new worker registers as the next generation; older ready generations drain
unsent openre.* events go to OpenVibe.Events from the coordinator's relay

conditions: automatic: deploy/scripts/deploy.sh switches back to the previous release when openre-api is not ready within 60 s
manual: a deploy of the previous release (workers: start the previous generation; the coordinator drains the newer one)
rollback.window: automatic during the 60 s readiness wait; manual while the previous release is still in releases/

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

claims.fencing: taken only when the row is the caller's or expired, so a deploy overlap leaves one coordinator acting

claims.what: a worker and every session it owns
claims.holder: the worker process (worker_id, generation) by heartbeat every 2 s
claims.expires: lost after 15 s without a heartbeat (OPENRE_WORKER_LEASE_MS); ingest sessions carry lease_expires_at
claims.fencing: the coordinator fails a lost worker's sessions (worker_lost) and reassigns its outputs; session changes are compare-and-set on state, so whoever commits first wins; new sessions reach only the newest ready generation

notes: Ingest and restream authority (ADR-009). Alpha: RTMP ingest and RTMP/SRT restream run in transport workers with generations and leases, separate from the API; WHIP, WebRTC/SFU and JSMPEG are still ingested by Live. Runs in parallel with Live; slots move one at a time behind Live's per-slot ingest_authority switch.
